subject: EU/APAC data residency & deployment mode follow-up
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sofie Løkke <sofie.lokke@finbank.dk>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up: EU/APAC data residency & deployment mode

Hi Sofie —

Thanks for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and next steps so we have alignment on the deployment constraints you mentioned:

- Primary requirement: EU-only processing for customer PII and transaction data (Nordics + EU), must not leave EU regions for those flows.
- Secondary requirement: APAC latency for your Singapore office (~30ms target) for anonymized read-only analytics. APAC can tolerate a different processing path if data is pseudonymized.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + encryption-in-transit & at-rest, KMS integration required. You flagged a future need for an on-prem option for air-gapped audits.
- Deployment modes discussed:
  - Hosted API (Redwood-hosted, EU region): easiest to stand up; supports EU-only routing today for production traffic, limited APAC edge presence for low-latency reads.
  - Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools in EU): gives predictable throughput and data isolation; can be configured with stricter network controls and private peering.
  - Private (VPC/on-prem): full control and auditability; best for strict residency & air-gapped needs but longer lead time and additional ops cost.

Action items / next steps:
1) I'll attach a short matrix (deployment-options-grid.xlsx) mapping latency, residency guarantees, and estimated monthly costs for each mode.
2) Please share any internal classification docs that spell out "data must remain in EU" (if available) so we can validate.
3) Marissa (cc'd) will run through the security questionnaire and follow up with KMS/HSM integration details.
4) Can we do a 30-minute technical call on Tue Nov 3 or Wed Nov 4 to map traffic flows and discuss proof-of-concept timing?

I've attached our RFI responses to the security questions we covered. If you prefer, we can also prepare a Dedicated capacity pricing estimate vs Private deployment rough order of magnitude.

Thanks —
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: RFI-answers.pdf, deployment-options-grid.xlsx

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few points:

- EU-only requirement: yes — customer PII + transaction logs must remain in EU. We can send the internal data classification later today.
- APAC: for now anonymized analytics only — we prefer Hosted if you can guarantee EU processing for PII and route anonymized analytics to APAC.
- KMS: we use our own AWS KMS key for any customer-specific encryption; we need to understand how Redwood supports customer-managed keys.

Tue Nov 3 at 10:00 CET (01:00 PST) works for the technical session if that's possible for Marissa/your team.

Procurement: looping in procurement@finbank.dk for timelines on security review and procurement windows.

— Sofie
Head of Data Operations, FinBank AS

Hi Sofie —

Thanks for confirming. A couple of notes on the KMS and routing:

- Customer-managed KMS: Redwood supports BYOK via AWS KMS and can integrate with your key policy. For Private deployments, we can also support HSM integrations with additional validation.
- Routing & residency: we can enforce per-route policies so that any route labeled "PII" is pinned to EU processing. For analytics routes labeled "anonymized" we can route to APAC edge replicas. We'll document how that labeling works in the traffic flow diagram during the technical call.
- Timeline: Hosted + strict routing can be stood up in ~2 weeks for a POC (EU-only for PII). Dedicated or Private will need procurement and network prep — estimate 4–8 weeks depending on networking.

I've attached the detailed RFI answers and a draft SLA (finbank-mop-sla-draft.docx). For the technical call, please add a short list of the endpoints/data classes you want pinned to EU.

Best,
Marissa Cole
